notes: TWO FIXES: CREDIT CARD IN CREDIT, AND LOANS AS DEBTS. 1) CARD REFUND. Logging the refund as an Adjustment on the card ('Owe less') takes it from -21,000 to +59,000; the next card expense reduces it (+49,000 after Rs 10k), and Net Worth moves +80,000 then -10,000. That part already worked. Fixed around it: Net Worth's Debts listed a card in credit as 'outstanding' (Math.abs), so a refund RAISED Debts. A card in credit is now owed TO you: not a debt, and shown in the Net Worth breakdown as 'Cards in credit (owed to you)'. The Edit balances account editor showed a card in credit as 'Amount owed' and saved it back as a debt (+59,000 became -59,000). It now has 'Card status: You owe this / In credit' and saves the sign correctly. Card adjustments now say '+ Owe more' and '- Owe less (refund / payment)'; other accounts keep '+ Add to balance' / '- Subtract from balance'. The Dashboard 'Liabilities' line uses the same figure as Net Worth Debts. 2) LOANS. A purchase only recorded its loan if it counted as an asset, so a car loan was owed nowhere. Now every loan's debt is one definition: at a month's end, every EMI still to pay after that month's EMI. This covers the plan's own EMIs (actual charged amounts, including step-ups, a close and Change my plan revisions; EMIs beyond the projection window at the last amount) and car, house, land or other loans in previewed or committed scenarios. A loan that has not started is not a debt yet. Net worth = what you own - what you owe: investments + cash + cards + land/house at its value that month - EMIs still to pay. Items that wear out (car, appliances) add no asset; land and house are worth their price grown monthly at the scenario's rate (default 6% a year, editable), with the existing 'You still own it afterwards' toggle for exceptions. Example: land Rs 100, Rs 20 down, Rs 80 at 9% for 10 years: purchase month Net Worth changes by 100 - 20 - 121.6; each EMI after that leaves it unchanged; appreciation raises it. Shared: emiDebtSeries/emiDebtByLoan (engine) plus scenario loan rows in scLiabSeries feed the engine's net worth, both rebuild passes and sharedNetWorthSeries. debtsAt() itemises Debts for the Net Worth page and Dashboard. The Net Worth total breakdown now sums exactly to its headline, using month-end cash; before, its parts subtracted EMIs the headline never did. EFFECT: Net Worth is now lower by the EMIs still to pay on every running loan (e.g. a parents' home loan from its start month). VERIFIED in headless Chromium on a plan shaped like the user's: 34 checks. They cover: breakdown sums to headline in 5 months with and without the car; car loan in Debts as EMI x 35, then x 34, gone after the last EMI; purchase-month Net Worth falls by down payment + every EMI; land worth price then price x 1.06 a year later, debt EMI x 119 then x 107; a not-yet-started loan absent then present with 119 left; Dashboard equals Net Worth Debts; card labels; refund to +59,000, not a debt, breakdown still adds up; account editor keeps credit and saves -59,000 only when 'You owe this' is chosen; a Change my plan EMI stop changes the debt; a committed car is counted once and equals its preview. Side-by-side with v2026.11.23.02: income, expenses, surplus, contributions, cash, investment and account balances identical, with and without the car; the Net Worth change equals the new loan debts in every month; Invest-more answers, car decision verdicts, Projection sheet and Budget page identical; all pages open with no errors; account row layout fits at 390px and 1280px. NOT VERIFIED: Safari; a real Firebase save. The guards sheetVsDash, decisionUsesChain, instrumentCrossPageMismatch and accountDeltaMismatches are not in the HTML file and were not run.
